result.sql:
WITH step_s1 AS (SELECT c.fips, COUNT(f.*)::double precision AS value FROM county_geom c LEFT JOIN public_schools_nces f ON ST_Intersects(c.geom, f.geom) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM epa_tsca_facilities n WHERE n.geom && ST_Expand(f.geom, $1::float8 / cos(radians(least(greatest(abs(ST_YMin(f.geom)), abs(ST_YMax(f.geom))) + $1::float8, 89.9))), $1::float8) AND ST_DWithin(f.geom::geography, n.geom::geography, $2)) GROUP BY c.fips),
     step_s2 AS (SELECT fips, value FROM acs_county_values WHERE census_code = $3 AND year = (SELECT max(year) FROM acs_county_values WHERE census_code = $3)),
     step_s3 AS (SELECT a.fips, a.value FROM step_s1 a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM step_s2 b WHERE b.fips = a.fips)),
     step_s4 AS (SELECT NULL::char(5) AS fips, SUM(value) AS value FROM step_s3)
SELECT r.fips, g.name, g.state_fp, r.value,
       CASE WHEN g.geom IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ST_AsGeoJSON(g.geom) END AS geometry
FROM step_s4 r
LEFT JOIN county_geom g USING (fips)
ORDER BY r.value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000
